requested_by_user: ImageGen illustrations, converted into SVG; GitHub-inspired scientific style

prompts.cloning_initial: Use case: scientific-educational. Asset type: original scientific workflow illustration for an English TFEB molecular biology course report, to be converted to real SVG vector paths. Style references: the restrained flat scientific SVG illustration approach of the GitHub Bioicons project (bioicons.com), and aligned left-to-right spacing of d2lang/d2; create original artwork, not logos or copied icons. Create ONE wide horizontal strip, aspect ratio 3:1, pure white background. Exactly FOUR equally spaced conceptual illustrations centered at x=12.5%,37.5%,62.5%,87.5%, y=50%. Leave generous white gaps between objects and equal margins. Each object uses at most 17% of the total image width, similar visual weight. From left: (1) a short double-stranded DNA fragment with clean paired rails and regular rungs, both strands clearly distinct; (2) one simple circular recombinant plasmid with teal insert arc and cyan tag arc, no features or coordinates; (3) one bacterial agar Petri dish with a few isolated round teal colonies, simple shallow perspective, no realistic texture; (4) two simple antiparallel straight DNA tracks, with small equal rungs, symbolizing forward and reverse sequence verification, absolutely NO sequencing peaks or chromatograms. No arrows between objects because those will be typeset later. Palette strictly limited to dark blue #3C5488, teal #00A087, cyan #4DBBD5, pale teal #91D1C2, charcoal #222222 and white #FFFFFF. Crisp flat fills and smooth clean outlines, elegant scientific journal illustration, restrained shape detail, no gradients, no shadows, no 3D glossy effects, no decoration. Absolutely no letters, words, numbers, captions, legend, title or watermark. These are conceptual icons, not experimental data. Keep all four objects separate and completely visible. Target 1536x512.
prompts.cloning_revision: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit this cloning-workflow icon strip. Preserve the first three objects exactly (DNA, circular plasmid, Petri dish), their positions, palette, white background and spacing. Replace ONLY the fourth/rightmost object. The replacement must be a clean symbolic bidirectional sequence verification motif: TWO complete straight horizontal double-stranded DNA ladders, each with two full-length parallel navy rails connected by regular teal rungs. The upper ladder has a small thin teal right-pointing arrow just above it; the lower ladder has a small thin teal left-pointing arrow just below it. Equal full lengths, no dots at ends, no dangling unpaired rungs, no sequence letters, no peaks, no chromatogram or results chart. Match the visual weight of the first three illustrations and keep everything within the rightmost quarter. No other text, numbers, annotations or decoration. Crisp solid colors only, no gradient or shadow.
prompts.evidence: Use case: scientific-educational. Asset: original concept illustration for a TFEB biology manuscript, to be vector-traced into SVG. Create one clean horizontal scientific illustration strip, 3:1 wide aspect ratio, pure white background, inspired by the flat scientific SVG approach of the Bioicons GitHub library and the aligned layout discipline of d2lang/d2. Exactly THREE separate illustrated objects centered at 16.7%, 50%, 83.3% of total width, all at mid-height with generous equal white gaps. Objects have equal visual weight and occupy at most 20% of total width. LEFT: a minimal circular recombinant plasmid ring, mostly dark blue with one teal arc and one cyan arc, no annotation. MIDDLE: a simplified eukaryotic cell seen from above, smooth navy outer outline, very pale teal interior, clearly bounded round teal nucleus, small abstract teal protein dots in nucleus and cytoplasm; schematic, no organelle clutter, no microscope realism. RIGHT: a short double-stranded DNA segment above three short wavy teal RNA transcripts, representing transcriptional output, with no chart, bars or numbers. Style: crisp flat vector-like filled geometry, restrained elegant journal figure, consistent medium outline weight and smooth curves. Only colors #3C5488 navy, #00A087 teal, #4DBBD5 cyan, #91D1C2 pale teal and #FFFFFF white. Solid fills only, no gradients, highlights, shadows, textures or glossy effects. Absolutely no text, labels, arrows, letters, numbers, panel labels, logo or watermark; exact labels and connecting arrows will be added in SVG afterwards. Icons are conceptual, not data. Keep objects fully contained without cropping. Target 1536x512.
